newsitem.title: UK: Perry tells Saddam Hussein to move A-A missiles.
newsitem.headline: Perry tells Saddam Hussein to move A-A missiles.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry on Monday warned Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein to stop deploying anti-aircraft missile batteries in the extended southern Iraqi no-fly zone or face the consequences.
Perry issued the warning after talks in London with British Defence Secretary Michael Portillo and French Defence Minister Charles Millon.

"Saddam Hussein poses a threat to our airmen, not only by the six missile firings carried out in the past days but also by the aggressive deployment of mobile surface-to-air missile units ... in the southern sector," Perry told reporters.
"All of these actions we find threatening, we find provoking and we find necessary he change," Perry added.
Perry said President Clinton had warned the Iraqi leader that the Western allies reserved the right to take any action they saw fit "and our position still stands."
